teaching_carrier.ordinary_lowercase: Source a–s map in alphabetic order to the first19 signs in ordinary_signs; t–z map to q followed by the first7 ordinary signs. This is one general letter table, never a word table.
teaching_carrier.rare_character_rule: For zero-based index j in rare_characters_in_order, write y followed by rare_selectors[floor(j/8)] and rare_selectors[j mod 8]. All three marks are consumed as one source character. Unlisted source characters are outside this teaching edition and cause an explicit failure, never deletion or guessed replacement.
teaching_carrier.marker: r never occurs in the letter carrier and is reserved for the mechanism declared in this card.
teaching_carrier.source_contract: Inputs are nonempty source tokens separated by single spaces, with explicit paragraph breaks. Uppercase, listed punctuation and digits are retained by the rare-character table. Repeated whitespace and exact physical source lineation are outside the declared input contract; semantic words, word order and paragraph boundaries are retained. No lowercasing, grammatical normalization or expansion of ambiguous historical spelling is performed.
teaching_carrier.reader_cost: The learner must know the source language, its ordinary spellings, the26 lowercase entries and the entire listed rare-character table, plus the mechanism-specific table/rules. Rare-character escape can be slow and long; its cost is charged. Drawings are already familiar transcription-designated shapes, but their artificial assignment is not a native letter or word-value claim.
teaching_carrier.decoding: Parse ordinary single signs, q plus exactly one permitted letter selector, or y plus exactly two rare selectors; reject unused combinations. The distinct marker r cannot be confused with a spelled source character. Multi-letter transcription labels such as ch name one working drawing here, without claiming that native writing has independently established these atoms.

title: RAW UNREVIEWED: deterministic vowel-run pieces with explicit word-continuation marks
summary: Ordinary source words are spelled through the general alphabet and divided by a fixed orthographic rule into visible pieces. A written continuation marker preserves which gaps are internal to a source word. This is orthographic chunking, not a claim about real syllables or manuscript spaces.

split_rule: For a token consisting entirely of lowercase a–z, find its maximal nonempty contiguous vowel runs. If there are two or more runs, cut immediately after every vowel run except the last; thus preceding consonants belong to the following run, while all trailing consonants stay in the final piece.

A lowercase token with zero or one vowel run remains one piece. Any token containing uppercase, punctuation, a digit or another listed rare character remains one unsplit piece under this edition; all characters are still encoded exactly.
Spell each piece with the common alphabet. Append a single r to every nonfinal piece of the same original token. Write a visible space after each piece. Final pieces carry no r.
decode: Within a visible group, decode its ordinary character units, allowing r only once at the very end. If terminal r is present, append the decoded piece to the next piece without a source word space. Otherwise finish the original token and restore its source word boundary.
Reject empty groups, internal r, repeated terminal r and a continuation left open at paragraph end. Re-encode the recovered token under the exact split rule to reject any alternate division.
Paragraph breaks are retained. Physical lines can wrap between pieces without closing continuation; the terminal mark, rather than line position, controls concatenation.
design.single_new_and_repeat: Every new source word follows the same spelling/split procedure without lexical lookup. A one-character input stays one unmarked piece. Repeated letters are preserved; a repeated vowel remains in its same maximal vowel run. Repeated full words repeat all their pieces and continuation marks.
design.constructive_example: At the pre-carrier teaching level 'schreiben' divides as 'schrei' plus 'ben'; only the first piece receives r. 'see' and 'br' remain single pieces. These are ordinary illustrative strings and are not target word assignments.
design.learning_cost: The common character tables, the five-vowel set, one maximal-run division rule and the terminal continuation rule; no shortcut lexicon or new semantic roots. Every extra internal gap requires an extra written mark. The learner must retain ordinary source spelling.
design.necessary_observable_difference: For a split token, every nonfinal decoded piece ends at a maximal vowel-run boundary and carries explicit r; every final piece lacks r. Source word identity is reconstructed by a visible continuation chain, never guessed from frequency. Plain alphabet renaming preserves spaces and has no such forced chain law.
design.smallest_falsifier: Given the printed rule, a human must recover exact source word boundaries for an unseen ordinary message containing several vowel runs, repeated words and a physical line wrap. A dangling chain, alternative undecidable source tokenization or a division inconsistent with the fixed vowel-run law falsifies this lesson. A later native binding must expose corresponding continuation behavior; raw pieces alone cannot establish it.
design.strongest_counterexample: Extra continuation marks may increase writing effort and visible type repetition rather than compress text. English-like and German-like vowel spellings are not universal syllables; tokens outside lowercase a–z receive no splitting benefit. Existing GDT907/910 findings do not support a general native word-continuation interpretation. A native use of the chosen continuation shape inside ordinary bodies would refute that exact binding.
design.statistical_limit: No measured effect or target match. The proposal deliberately changes the unit counted as a visible group, so natural-word frequencies cannot be compared without applying the declared encoder and charging continuation marks. No discretionary split is allowed to tune an output histogram.
